blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House private prosecutor Lorna Kapunan on Friday raised questions over a massive P568-million discrepancy between the declared sales and actual bank deposits of Cale88 Foods Corp., a firm linked to Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, lawyer Manases Carpio. At a press briefing, Kapunan noted that while Cale88 declared only P208.49 million in sales to the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR), records from the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) revealed total bank inflows reaching P776.64 million. “The sales declared to the BIR were P208.49 million.
